sf-handheld.name: Handheld laser welders, 0.8 – 3 kW — portable air-cooled S series and HWM series
sf-handheld.models_label: SF3S · SF4S · SF5S · SF1500HWM · SF2000HWM · SF3000HWM
sf-handheld.summary: A handheld laser welder replaces TIG on stainless, aluminum, galvanized and carbon steel sheet: a 1.5 lb gun, a seam five times faster than TIG, almost no heat distortion and no grinding afterwards — an operator learns it in a day. The S series is the portable one: 0.8 to 1.5 kW, air-cooled, 99 to 121 lb on wheels, plugged into a 220 V outlet. The HWM series brings 1.5 to 3 kW with a water chiller and a wire feeder for welds to 9/32″, and a 4-in-1 head that welds, cleans, cuts and seam-welds. CE face shield, protective clothing and an optional welding booth come with it.
features: S series: 0.8 / 1.2 / 1.5 kW air-cooled, 99 – 121 lb; HWM: 1.5 / 2 / 3 kW, welds to 9/32″, wire feeder
1.5 lb (0.7 kg) welding gun with wire feed; 16 – 33 ft cable
Self-developed laser source and 4-in-1 welding head (weld, clean, cut, seam)
Safety: CE face shield, laser-resistant clothing and gloves supplied; optional booth with protective glass
CE / FDA certified; S series 220 V single-phase, HWM 3-phase
optional: Robot + handheld combination (robot CRP-RH18-20 with the same source)

sf-robot-weld.name: Robotic laser welding cells, 1.5 – 20 kW, and robotic arc welders
sf-robot-weld.summary: The RW series puts a fiber laser on a 6-axis robot with 72″ reach: 1.5 to 20 kW for sheet to 9/16″, with horizontal or dual-axis positioners for tanks and tubes and 7 to 9-axis cells on a linear track. For MIG/MAG the RMW is a teaching-free robot that scans the part and programs the weld itself, and the CMW is a collaborative robot on a mobile cart with a 59 × 59″ 3D fixture table — 350 or 500 A, programmed by hand-guiding, moved to the job on wheels.
features: RW: 6-axis robot, 1.5 – 20 kW, welds to 9/16″ (14 mm); positioners and linear tracks
RMW: teaching-free 500 A MIG/MAG; CMW: cobot 350 / 500 A on a cart with 3D fixture table
Safety fencing, light curtains and fume extraction interfaces; 208 / 240 / 480 / 600 V 3-phase 60 Hz (transformer supplied); single-phase not available

sf-cladding.name: Laser cladding machines, 6 / 12 kW — shafts, rolls, bores and on-site repair
sf-cladding.summary: Laser cladding lays a metallurgically bonded wear or corrosion layer — up to 25/64″ thick — onto shafts, rolls, hydraulic cylinders, valves and dies with far less heat than overlay welding and far better bonding than spraying. The SFR6063 robot cell handles workpieces to 20 ft and 15 t on its table; the SFHS3050 and 6050 are lathe-type machines for shafts to 10 and 20 ft; the SFMR02 is the portable system that goes to the machine for on-site repair. All with Senfeng's high-speed cladding head, dual-cylinder powder feeder and an inner-bore head as an option.
features: 6 or 12 kW; high-speed cladding head; dual-cylinder pneumatic powder feeder, 20 – 300 µm, to 150 g/min
KUKA / FANUC robot (SFR, SFMR) or lathe bed with Ø19.7″ three-jaw chuck (SFHS)
Coatings to 25/64″ (10 mm) with metallurgical bonding and small heat-affected zone; 208 / 240 / 480 / 600 V 3-phase 60 Hz (transformer supplied); single-phase not available
